name: schedules-delivery-start
description: Stage 2 of #612: a schedule whose agent is not running starts it. The coordinator boots, its timer fires the overdue schedule, a second kollab process comes online as the target agent (launched through kollab_argv, --detached --as), and the fire is recorded ok in schedules-runs.jsonl. Scratch HOME, --no-daemon, no keyring.

setup.description: seed an overdue schedule for an agent that is not running

steps.description: the coordinator started the stopped agent for the fire
steps.command: for i in $(seq 1 50); do grep -rq "schedules: s1 started probe-agent for the fire" "$HOME/.kollab/projects" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 1; done; echo 'no start line in the logs'; exit 1

steps.description: the started agent runs as its own process (--as probe-agent)
steps.command: for i in $(seq 1 20); do /bin/ps axeww -o command= | grep -v grep | grep -- "--as probe-agent" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; echo 'no probe-agent process'; exit 1

steps.description: the fire is recorded ok (the start itself delivered the prompt)
steps.command: for i in $(seq 1 55); do [ -s "$HOME/.kollab/schedules-runs.jsonl" ] && exit 0; sleep 1; done; echo 'no run recorded'; exit 1

steps.description: the run record names the schedule and result ok
